description:
The CT Cranium DICOM dataset is loaded in InVesalius. A trauma surgeon needs 'thick slab' reconstructions to simulate plain-film X-rays for a fracture assessment. 

Perform the following steps:
1. Select the Coronal view and adjust the Slice Thickness to at least 40.0 mm (creating a transparent 'X-ray' look).
2. Export this Coronal thick-slab view as a PNG image to '/home/ga/Documents/coronal_thick_slab.png'.
3. Select the Sagittal view, ensure the Slice Thickness is at least 40.0 mm.
4. Export this Sagittal thick-slab view as a PNG image to '/home/ga/Documents/sagittal_thick_slab.png'.

Login credentials (if needed): username 'ga', password 'password123'.
